presets.title: Essential assurance
presets.description: CampusWeave limited-disruption profile of explicitly reviewed firewall, platform-integrity, and threat-scanning controls.
presets.rationale: Establish basic endpoint defenses using only source-backed, schema-validated settings from the curated list.
presets.impact: Can change firewall traffic handling, Gatekeeper assessment, or device threat scanning.
prerequisites: Validate device applicability and test the generated plan before assignment.

settingRationales./EnableFirewall: Die in macOS integrierte Personal Firewall SOLLTE aktiviert und geeignet konfiguriert werden.

settingRationales./minLength: Requiring at least six character minimum length provides reasonable assurance against passcode attacks.

presets.title: Managed assurance
presets.description: CampusWeave managed-device profile that inherits Essential and adds explicitly reviewed encryption, recovery, passcode, and developer-mode controls.
presets.rationale: Add controls whose operational cost is appropriate only after ownership, support, and recovery responsibilities are assigned.
presets.impact: Can require stronger passcodes, disable developer capabilities, and change disk-encryption and recovery-key handling.
prerequisites: Complete Essential validation and confirm managed-device ownership, FileVault recovery escrow, and support readiness.

settingRationales./developerSettings: In allen Android-basierten Geräten SOLLTE der Entwicklermodus deaktiviert sein.

settingRationales./forceEncryptedBackup: Data that are stored securely on an iOS or iPadOS device may be trivially accessed from a local computer backup. Forcing the encryption of backups protects data from being compromised if the local host computer is compromised. Use of backups is strongly advised as they allow the creation of a copy of data that can be recovered in the event of failures, such as hardware or software failure, data corruption, human-caused event, or accidental deletion of data. Backup copies allow data to be restored from an earlier point in time to help recover from an unexpected event.

Data that are stored securely on an iOS or iPadOS device may be trivially accessed from a local computer. Forcing the encryption of backups significantly reduces the likelihood of sensitive data being compromised if the local host computer is compromised.

settingRationales./untrustedAppsPolicy: Google lists blocking installation from unknown sources as a default Android Enterprise security policy.

settingRationales./fdeFileVault/enable: Apple documents FileVault as built-in full-volume encryption for managed Mac computers.

settingRationales./enableRecoveryKeyEscrow: Apple documents device-management escrow of FileVault personal recovery keys.
settingRationales./fdeFileVault/useRecoveryKey: Apple documents device-management escrow of FileVault personal recovery keys.

presets.title: High assurance
presets.description: CampusWeave restrictive profile that inherits Managed and adds only explicitly reviewed restrictive controls.
presets.rationale: Require explicit operational review before using the most restrictive CampusWeave profile.
presets.impact: Restrictive controls can interrupt access, recovery, enrollment, or critical workflows.
prerequisites: Document a readiness review, recovery path, exception ownership, and deployment rollback plan.

settingRationales./allowFilesUSBDriveAccess: The Files app provides a local file system and interface to USB media for iOS and iPadOS devices. In environments with sensitive data and strict data loss prevention policies, disabling the use of USB media with such devices may reduce the risk of data leakage.

settingRationales./allowAirDrop: AirDrop can allow malicious files to be downloaded from unknown sources. Contacts Only limits may expose personal information to devices in the same area.

settingRationales./unifiedLockSettings: Google documents a separate work-profile security challenge for work data isolation.

settingRationales./cloudBlockLevel: Microsoft lists this as a default setting in the current Windows 11 version 25H2 Intune MDM baseline for managed Windows devices.
